## Academic service & leadership

Alongside research and teaching, I have contributed to **academic publishing, peer review, programme and institutional development, international collaboration, conference organisation and student engagement**. These activities span academic institutions and professional networks in the United Kingdom, United States, Pakistan, Germany and China.

#### Peer review

I have served as a peer reviewer for **24 academic journals** across environmental politics, psychology, energy, sustainability, risk and public policy, including *Nature Energy*, *Landscape and Urban Planning*, *Cell Reports Sustainability*, *Journal of Environmental Psychology*, *Energy Research & Social Science*, *Scientific Reports*, *Environmental Politics* and *Society & Natural Resources*.

#### Departmental leadership

My wider departmental responsibilities at GC University Lahore included membership of the **Departmental Academic Committee**, management of departmental budgets and financial records, coordination of Turnitin provision, and supervision of administrative staff.

### Student engagement

At GC University Lahore, I established the **Parliamentary Student Society** and served as its Faculty Adviser from 2015 to 2017. I also served as **Co-In-Charge of the Quaid-e-Azam Political Science Society** from 2009 to 2014.

These roles complemented my formal teaching and research supervision by creating opportunities for students to develop academic engagement, communication, leadership and confidence beyond the classroom.
